requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0xCCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY when starting the watchdog.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the value 0xCCCC is written to IWDG_KR.KEY and the register array reflects this value.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0xAAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY when refreshing the watchdog counter.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the value 0xAAAA is written to IWDG_KR.KEY and the register array reflects this value.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the key value 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY when enabling write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR.
requirements.verification: The test passes when the value 0x5555 is written to IWDG_KR.KEY and the register array reflects this value.

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write a key value different from 0x5555 to IWDG_KR.KEY when disabling write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR.
requirements.verification: The test passes when any value other than 0x5555 is written to IWDG_KR.KEY and the register array reflects this value.

requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the IWDG LL driver shall not write any IWDG register.
requirements.verification: The test passes when no writes occur to any IWDG register before any LL function is invoked after reset.
